dish: Friday cod or catfish fish fry, fried perch, the hand-mixed brandy old fashioned, hashbrowns with American cheese on top
address: 3717 S Dutch Mill Rd, Madison, WI 53718
w: A south-east-side roadhouse supper club in some form since the 1930s, still family-run, with the relish tray, cinnamon rolls and frog legs of the classic Wisconsin menu. Swept the 2025 Madison reader vote: best restaurant, best fish fry and best old fashioned.

dish: Beer-battered cheese curds (house recipe batter) and the Friday fish fry
w: The Capitol Square's all-Wisconsin tavern and supper-club homage — Wisconsin beers, brandy old fashioneds and curds. Voted Madison's best cheese curds in the 2025 reader survey and named by Isthmus associate editor Linda Falkenstein among her top fish fries.

dish: Barrel-aged brandy old fashioned and old-school steakhouse steaks
w: Off the Capitol Square, an old-school supper-club steakhouse with classic service — 2012 James Beard Best Chef Tory Miller's date-night pick, and runner-up for Madison's best old fashioned in the 2025 reader vote.
